scope: Official LGIA and GeoNetwork metadata only. No JPEG bodies, orthophoto imagery, pixels, candidate coordinates, GIS, external contacts, or license signing.

cycle8_product.vintage: 8th aerial-photography cycle, 2022–2024; LGIA page says work started spring 2022, intended 20 cm, RGBI and CIR; eastern-border coverage gaps are to be complemented with satellite imagery.
cycle8_product.coverage_caveat: Product page speaks of the Latvia-wide cycle, but GeoNetwork dataset abstracts identify the current WMS record as Kurzeme region and say the area orthophoto scheme is incomplete; no page-level sheet/date table or feature schema was found.

public_metadata_catalog.search: A targeted CSW GetRecords query returned four cycle-8 records matching 2022 and 8. cikls: color and infrared dataset records plus color and infrared service records.

records.note: Published box is axis-order-confused/reversed in west/east values; not used for spatial claims.

records.onlineOperationUrl: blank in metadata; GetCapabilities operation is listed but connectPoint URL is empty.
records.resourceUseConstraints: Machine-readable record says no public-access limitations and use conditions unknown, which conflicts with explicit signed-license abstract and LGIA WMS services listing.

records.abstract: Service available free after the client signs a license; same application path.

public_metadata_catalog.date_schema: No per-sheet/per-feature date fields, date-footprint layer schema, download URL, or openly licensed vector footprint is published in these four metadata records. The cycle period and metadata publication/revision dates are not individual flight dates.

rights.catalogue_statement: Cycle 8 RGB/CIR orthophoto maps with aerial photography time map WMS are free data with access authorized after client signs the license.
rights.open_data_statement: LGIA says products up to and including cycle 6 are available as Open Data; cycle 8 is outside that stated open-data group.
rights.static_plan_rights: Two JPG plan files are publicly linked and HEAD returns 200, but no separate license for reuse was located. They are static JPEG schematics, not queryable source vectors; bodies were not fetched.

service_path_result: Public GeoNetwork CSW exposes source metadata records without client license, but it does not expose the underlying cycle-8 WMS endpoint. The product page links only two static JPEG schemes. No official publicly queryable date-feature service or provider-published vector/member ≤32 MiB was identified in the reviewed primary sources.

cycle6_separate_history.positive_rights: Cycle 6 has a CC BY 4.0 official metadata archive.
cycle6_separate_history.engineering_disposition: Ineligible for cycle-8 physical-observation/acceptance requirements; its SHP decoded member is 108,040,732 bytes, over 32 MiB; do not decode/process as substitute.
